rules.key: Your fleet may include a fleet commander to lead it if you wish
rules.text: Your fleet may include a fleet commander to lead it if you wish.

rules.key: Your fleet must include a commander if it is greater than 750 pts
rules.text: Your fleet must include a commander if it is greater than 750 pts.

rules.key: the commander may be either a Kor
rules.text: The commander may be either a Kor'O or Kor'el.
rules.why: Kirjassa lause alkaa pienella kirjaimella; jatetty sellaiseksi. Molemmat rivit ovat listalla, ja osion 0-1 raja huolehtii siita etta vain toinen valitaan.

rules.key: The commander has one re-roll included in his points cost
rules.text: The commander has one re-roll included in his points cost.
rules.why: Nakyy komentajaosion tekstina 9.9.2026 alkaen (lausesuodatin tuntee re-roll- ja leadership-sanat, P1-8e). Sisaltyva re-roll on ratkaisimen rerolls.included-kentassa ja komentajakortilla; laivastovalidaattori ei valvo re-rollien maaraa.

rules.key: the commander's ship may carry a member of the Ethereal caste
rules.text: If you wish, the commander's ship may carry a member of the Ethereal caste and therefore purchase additional re-rolls at the cost shown.
rules.why: Aun'el ja Aun'O ovat paivitysrivaja komentajan alla.

rules.key: Your fleet may include any number of battleships
rules.text: Your fleet may include any number of battleships.
rules.why: Ei rajoita mitaan. Osiossa on vain Explorer.

rules.key: it must include at least one Explorer
rules.text: If your fleets is worth more than 750 pts it must include at least one Explorer.
rules.why: Kirjoitettu kasin. Lause ei mainitse osion otsikkoa 'Battleships', ja osiovartija hylkasi sen siksi - vartija on olemassa juuri siksi ettei osiolaskuri mittaisi vaaraa osiota. Kirjassa on painovirhe 'your fleets'; jatetty sellaiseksi.

rules.key: Your fleet may include any number of Merchant class starships
rules.text: Your fleet may include any number of Merchant class starships.

rules.key: one Hero class starship for every Merchant or Explorer
rules.text: It may also include up to one Hero class starship for every Merchant or Explorer in the fleet.
rules.why: Kirjoitettu kasin: nimittaja on kaksi ALUSLUOKKAA kahdesta eri osiosta (Merchant Cruisers-osiossa, Explorer Battleships-osiossa), eika kumpikaan ole osion otsikko.

rules.key: one Messenger class starship per 500 points
rules.text: Your fleet may include up to one Messenger class starship per 500 points.
rules.why: Kirjoitettu kasin: ESCORTS-osiossa on nelja muutakin alusta, joten laskenta on rajattava nimella. Pisterajoille lisattiin 7.9.2026 sama nimisuodatin joka suhdeluvuilla jo oli.

rules.key: Your fleet may include any number of Defender class starships
rules.text: Your fleet may include any number of Defender class starships.

rules.key: You may not have more Orcas and Wardens than the gravitic hook capacity
rules.text: You may not have more Orcas and Wardens than the gravitic hook capacity of the fleet.
rules.why: Valvottu 14.9.2026 (J95): kapasiteetti luetaan profiilin koukkuriveilta (esim. Explorer 3 x 'Capacity: 1 Orca/Warden', s.458), ja laivastotason saanto on 'Gravitic hook capacity (Orcas and Wardens)'.

rules.key: Any ship equipped with Wardens can only be equipped with Wardens
rules.text: Any ship equipped with Wardens can only be equipped with Wardens and may not have other hook-transported escorts.
rules.why: Sidos emoalukseen; sovellus ei sido saattajia emoaluksiin.

rules.key: A ship may have either Orcas or Dhows, but not both
rules.text: A ship may have either Orcas or Dhows, but not both so the gravitic hook capacity of the fleet is divided between Orcas and Dhows.
rules.why: Aluskohtaista jakoa (mika alus kantaa mita) ei mallinneta (J8). Lauseen seuraus, eli kapasiteetin jakautuminen Orcien ja Dhowien kesken, on valvottu saannolla 'Gravitic hook capacity (Dhows and Orcas)' (J95).

rules.key: Defenders are fielded in squadrons of 2
rules.text: Defenders are fielded in squadrons of 2-6 ships.
rules.why: Korjattu 10.9.2026 (laivastopistokoe S2, raportti 17): saanto oli SQUADRONS-osiossa, jossa ei ole aluksia, eika tarkistanut mitaan. Nyt pick nimeaa Defender-luokan ESCORTS-osiosta; Messengerit saavat toimia yksin ('Messengers operate as single ships, or in squadrons').

rules.key: up to one Warsphere if the fleet is worth 1500 points
rules.text: A Tau fleet can include up to one Warsphere if the fleet is worth 1500 points, or up to two Warspheres in games larger than that.
rules.why: Valvottu 9.9.2026 (kohta 8): kirjasta luettu saanto lisatty build_data.py:n RULE_PICKS-tauluun; resolveFleet tarkistaa sen. tiers: 1500 -> 1, yli 1500 -> 2. Aiempi puute: Ehdollinen porrastus ('jos 1500, niin yksi; sita isommissa kaksi'), ei tasainen suhde pisteisiin. Moottorin per_points laskee tasaisesti, joten se antaisi 3000

rules.key: one Demiurg vessel for every three Tau capital ships
rules.text: A Tau fleet can include up to one Demiurg vessel for every three Tau capital ships in the fleet.
rules.why: Kirjoitettu kasin: nimittaja 'Tau capital ships' tarkoittaa kahta osiota (Battleships ja Cruisers), eika osioiden ratkaisu loyda sita.

rules.key: Nicassar Dhows in place of some or all of its Orcas
rules.text: Your fleet may include Nicassar Dhows in place of some or all of its Orcas.
rules.why: Vaihtokauppa Orcojen kanssa; molemmat rajoittuvat gravitic hook -kapasiteettiin, jota ei valvota.

notes: Explorer, Hero ja Merchant esiintyvat listalla kahtena rivina kumpikin ('- Vash'ya Mk XXIII configuration' jne). Se ei ole virhe: kirjan profiilisivuilla on samasta rungosta useampi konfiguraatio, ja sovellus tarjoaa ne erikseen samaan hintaan.

Otsikko 'ALLIES, SUBJECTS & MERCENARIES' sisaltaa pilkun, jota otsikkokaava ei salli. Se oli 7.9.2026 asti tavallista tekstia, jolloin palkkasoturikappale valui SQUADRONS-osion peraan. Pilkkua ei voi sallia kaavassa (kirjan kaksiriviset otsikot katkeaisivat vaarasta kohdasta), joten tama otsikko on nimetty poikkeus.
Listan kolme keskeisinta rajoitetta olivat 7.9.2026 asti kokonaan valvomatta, kaikki samasta syysta: kirja nimeaa ALUSLUOKAN siella missa moottori odottaa osion otsikkoa.
Gravitic hook -kapasiteetti on listan ainoa asia jota ei voi valvoa lainkaan: se lukee runkoalusten profiileissa, ei listariveilla. Orcojen, Wardenien ja Dhowien maara riippuu siita.
